images.prompt:
Original printable Christmas greeting-card artwork in a hand-painted storybook watercolour style: fine irregular pencil-and-ink accents, organic softly broken contours, medium-detail believable-but-charming woodland animals, translucent mottled pigment on subtle cold-pressed paper texture, muted russet, pine green, sage, blue-grey, creamy ivory, burgundy and restrained antique-gold palette. Soft layered winter shading, dry-brush snow, delicate fur and foliage marks, gentle warm star-fleck glow, airy pale background and an uncluttered upper-third area reserved for separately added greeting text. Portrait composition, calm cosy nostalgic mood, home-print-friendly focal shapes and clear value contrast.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original woodland winter greeting-card illustration with a single red fox delivering a small parcel through a snowy pine grove; hand-painted storybook watercolour with subtle ink detailing.; line weight: Fine, varied pencil-and-ink accents; delicate directional marks for fur, needles and parcel ribbon, with no heavy outlines.; line quality: Organic, softly broken and hand-rendered contours that dissolve naturally into watercolour edges.; detail level: Medium detail: a clear focal fox with tactile fur and knitted scarf, supported by simplified layered trees, snowdrifts, stars and a few restrained festive details suitable for reliable home printing.; character language: Broadly believable but gently charming fox anatomy, three-quarter side view in a walking pose; alert ears, small dark eyes, soft expression and an oversized russet tail. The fox wears a plain burgundy knitted scarf and carries a tiny wrapped kraft-paper parcel tied with a forest-green ribbon.; background density: Airy winter woodland vignette. Pale ivory sky, softly receding blue-grey pine silhouettes and rounded snowbanks leave generous uncluttered space in the upper third for a greeting added during layout.; composition: Portrait folded-card front, with the fox walking across the lower middle of the artwork from left to right. A loose crescent of snow-dusted pine boughs and faint falling snow frames the focal character without creating a border; preserve a clean upper-third text area.; palette: Muted russet and warm brown fox tones; pine green, blue-grey and soft sage shadows; creamy ivory snow; burgundy scarf; forest-green ribbon; restrained antique-gold star flecks.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Layered translucent watercolour washes, soft cool winter shadows and a gentle warm glow around a few antique-gold star flecks; no hard cel shading or large dark ink-heavy areas.; texture: Subtle cold-pressed paper grain, mottled pigment variation, dry-brush snow edges, fine fur strokes and softly granular snow specks.; mood: Tender, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly festive..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Classic muted Christmas palette: evergreen, sage and pine; warm animal browns; creamy white snow and paper; antique gold; rusty red, burgundy, and occasional warm orange. Colours are earthy and gently desaturated rather than bright primary holiday hues.; linework: Reference 01 uses very fine, irregular pencil/ink-like contour and fur strokes, approximately 0.5–1 px at card-preview scale. References 02–03 are painterly and largely outline-free; forms are separated by value, texture, and rim light rather than graphic linework.; texture: Visible cold-pressed paper/wash texture, mottled pigment, soft dry-brush effects, fine fur strokes, knitted textile detail, granular snow, and bokeh-like light specks. Texture is decorative but supports form and atmosphere.; composition density: Varies from sparse portrait-led layout to dense cinematic vignettes. Use one clearly dominant focal subject; surrounding festive details should create a framing arc and depth without obscuring the subject.; background: From a near-white paper field with restrained flecks to layered, atmospheric winter environments. Complex scenes contain foreground, middle-ground, and softly receding background detail, with selective blur or low contrast at depth.; mood: Cosy, tender, nostalgic, magical, and quietly festive. The animals feel sweet and personable, while golden lighting conveys warmth and wonder..
